verdict.rationale: Next.js documents its own upgrade paths: a guide for upgrading from the Pages Router to the App Router, and codemods for upgrading a Next.js codebase when new features are released. Neither is shown to be a dedicated guide for moving between two specific incompatible major versions. missing for 10: explicit version-to-version major upgrade guides (e.g., breaking-change lists per major release), independent or hands-on corroboration that the upgrade guidance works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow a dedicated migration guide when moving between two incompatible major versions of the framework

citations.quote: Use codemods to upgrade your Next.js codebase when new features are released.
Learn how to upgrade your existing Next.js application from the Pages Router to the App Router.
